CRITICAL SYSTEM INSTRUCTION: LOSSLESS IMAGE TEXTUALIZATION
TARGET MODEL: GEMINI 3 PRO (VISION)
MODE: STRICT DATA EXTRACTION // NO CONVERSATION // NO SUMMARIZATION

TASK:
Convert the attached 16MP image into a COMPLETE textual database. You must act as a blind-extraction engine. Your output must describe 100% of the visual data present in the file.

CRITICAL RULES (DO NOT BREAK THEM):
1.  NO SUMMARIES. NO INTROS. NO OUTROS. Start directly with the data.
2.  NO "OVERVIEWS". Do not describe the "vibe" or "scene" generally. Describe the atoms.
3.  MAXIMUM VERBOSITY. If a detail exists in the pixels, it MUST be in the text.
4.  DO NOT HALLUCINATE. If a detail is blurry, state: "BLURRED_REGION [coords]". Do not guess.
5.  EXHAUSTIVE OBJECT LISTING. Do not say "a crowd of people". List: Person_1, Person_2, Person_3... Person_N.
6.  STRICT ATTRIBUTE EXTRACTION. For EVERY entity, you must define:
    - Exact Texture (e.g., "brushed cotton", not just "fabric")
    - Exact Color (Hex approximation + lighting condition)
    - Micro-details (scratches, dust, wrinkles, stains, seams)
    - Geometry & Spatial Coords (relative position)
7.  OCR IS MANDATORY. If there is text, transcribe it character-perfect. If cut off, transcribe the visible parts exactly.
8.  USE THE FULL CONTEXT WINDOW. Do not stop until every pixel cluster is accounted for.
9.  OUTPUT FORMAT: STRICT HIERARCHICAL MARKDOWN LIST (DEPTH 5+).

EXECUTION ALGORITHM:
1.  SCAN Background (Walls, Sky, Floor, Ground) -> Detailed material physics analysis.
2.  SCAN Middleground (Objects, Furniture, Vehicles) -> 360-degree mental reconstruction.
3.  SCAN Foreground (Subjects, Main Items) -> Forensic level detail.
4.  SCAN Subjects (If Humans/Animals):
    - Pores/Skin texture
    - Iris patterns (if visible)
    - Individual clothing fibers/seams
    - Exact finger positioning/joints
    - Micro-expressions (muscle tension maps)

OUTPUT TEMPLATE (REPEAT FOR EVERY SINGLE ELEMENT FOUND):

# SECTOR [TOP-LEFT / CENTER / ETC]
## ENTITY_ID: [Name]
- VISIBILITY: [0-100%]
- EXACT_POSITION: [X,Y relative]
- PHYSICAL_PROPERTIES:
  - Material: [Detailed]
  - Surface_State: [Clean/Dirty/Scratched/Wet]
  - Lighting_Interaction: [Reflective/Matte/Shadowed]
- SUB-COMPONENTS:
  - [Sub-part 1 details...]
  - [Sub-part 2 details...]
  - [Sub-part N details...]

[CONTINUE UNTIL IMAGE IS EMPTY. DO NOT SHORTEN. DO NOT SIMPLIFY. WRITE 20,000+ TOKENS IF NEEDED.]

entries.answer:
# SECTOR [BACKGROUND / BACKDROP]
## ENTITY_ID: Branded_Step_and_Repeat_Wall
- VISIBILITY: 100% (Spans entire background plane)
- EXACT_POSITION: Behind subject, occupying full Z-depth layer 0.
- PHYSICAL_PROPERTIES:
  - Material: Matte vinyl or tension fabric (low reflectivity).
  - Surface_State: Smooth, slight tension wrinkles absent, uniform flatness.
  - Lighting_Interaction: Absorbs ambient light; dark navy/charcoal base color (approx. Hex #1A222E). Slight gradient lightening towards the center-left due to frontal flash/lighting.
- SUB-COMPONENTS:
  - **Logo_1 (Top Left)**:
    - Text: "JADE" (Stylized, graffiti-tag aesthetic).
    - Font_Style: Custom hand-style typography with fluid, ribbon-like strokes.
    - Color: Silver/White with light blue drop shadow/glow effects (approx. Hex #DCEEF5).
    - Texture: Digitally printed gradient, giving a metallic chrome illusion.
    - Position: Upper left quadrant, floating above subject's head.
  - **Logo_2 (Center Right)**:
    - Text: "FENDI" [Cut off: "FEN..." visible, "DI" implied].
    - Subtext: "ROMA" (Small caps, situated below main text).
    - Font_Style: Sans-serif, bold, geometric uppercase.
    - Color: Pure White (Hex #FFFFFF).
    - Texture: Flat matte print.
    - Position: Middle right edge, partially obscured by flower bouquet elements.

# SECTOR [FOREGROUND / SUBJECT]
## ENTITY_ID: Human_Female_Subject
- VISIBILITY: 60% (Torso and lower face obscured by bouquet)
- EXACT_POSITION: Center-left frame, angled approx. 30 degrees toward frame-left.
- PHYSICAL_PROPERTIES:
  - Skin_Tone: Fair/Light (Type II), matte finish foundation.
  - Surface_State: Smooth texture, high-contrast makeup application.
  - Lighting_Interaction: Soft highlight on cheekbone and nose bridge; shadows falling on the right side of the face (jawline).
- SUB-COMPONENTS:
  - **Hair**:
    - Color: Jet Black (Hex #050505).
    - Texture: Straight, high-gloss sheen, fine strands.
    - Style: Center-parted, sleek, draped behind the ears and flowing over shoulders.
    - Physics: Static, no wind motion detected.
  - **Face**:
    - **Eyebrows**: Thin, arched, dark brown/black pencil defined.
    - **Eyes**: Heavy winged eyeliner (black liquid liner), dark mascara. Gaze directed off-camera to the left.
    - **Nose**: Straight bridge, small highlight on the tip.
    - **Mouth**: Smiling wide.
      - **Lips**: Full, painted with matte dark berry/brown-red lipstick (approx. Hex #4A1A1C). Sharp lipliner boundary.
      - **Teeth**: Visible upper row, white, regular alignment.
  - **Clothing (Visible Portion)**:
    - Item: Strapless top or dress bodice.
    - Color: Pale beige/cream (approx. Hex #EBE5CE).
    - Texture: Smooth fabric, possibly silk or fine polyester blend.
    - Fit: Fitted to torso.

# SECTOR [FOREGROUND / OBJECT]
## ENTITY_ID: Floral_Bouquet
- VISIBILITY: 40% of frame (Dominates bottom right quadrant)
- EXACT_POSITION: Held in subject's arms, extending from center chest to bottom right corner.
- PHYSICAL_PROPERTIES:
  - Composition: Mixed floral arrangement with heavy foliage.
  - Focus_State: Variable. Left side in focus, right side/foreground showing lens blur (bokeh).
- SUB-COMPONENTS:
  - **Flower_Type_A (Alstroemeria / Lily of the Incas)**:
    - Color: Orange/Red petals with yellow throat and dark brown speckling.
    - Location: Center of the bouquet mass.
    - State: Fully bloomed.
  - **Flower_Type_B (White Filler)**:
    - Type: Likely Gypsophila or small Daisies.
    - Color: White/Cream.
    - Location: Interspersed among greenery on the left side.
  - **Flower_Type_C (Red Bloom)**:
    - Type: Rose or similar dense petal flower.
    - Color: Deep Red.
    - Location: Bottom right edge (blurred).
  - **Foliage_A (Eucalyptus)**:
    - Color: Muted sage green/blue-green (Hex #4B6358).
    - Shape: Round, coin-shaped leaves attached to thin stems.
    - Texture: Matte, waxy surface.
  - **Foliage_B (Fern/Filler Greens)**:
    - Color: Forest green.
    - Shape: Needle-like or feathery fronds.
    - Location: Creating volume behind the main blooms.
  - **Structural_Element**:
    - Some blurred white wrapping or ribbon visible at the very bottom edge.

# SECTOR [IMAGE METADATA / ARTIFACTS]
## ENTITY_ID: Digital_Image_File
- VISIBILITY: N/A
- PHYSICAL_PROPERTIES:
  - Quality: Moderate. Visible noise/grain in shadow areas (background).
  - Illumination: Flash photography likely, causing "red-eye" reduction style reflection in skin oils and "flat" lighting on the backdrop.
  - Depth_of_Field: Shallow. Subject's face is sharp; front-most leaves of the bouquet are soft/out of focus.
